Greater Deathstones are created by combining 100 Lesser Deathstones. They can also be looted from Death's Essence. They are used to purchase items from Archmage Tarsis Kir-Moldir in Naxxramas during the Season of Mastery.
Great Shot! is a reputation achievement earned by taking a "Great Shot" while cataloging wildlife.
Great Shots Galore! is a reputation achievement earned by taking 100 "Great Shots" while cataloging wildlife.

Greater Obsidian Key is created by combining 30 Key Fragments and 3 Key Framing, which drop from mobs in and around the Obsidian Citadel in the Waking Shores. Once a week, players can create one of these greater keys and trade it in to Wrathion or Sabellian, depending on which faction they chose to ally with for the week for Allegiance to One. Subsequent keys created are Restored Obsidian Key, which can be turned in to additional NPCs repeatedly.
Greatcloak of the Virtuous Protector is available for purchase from the Trading Post during March for 50 Trader's Tender.

Greater Venomsprout is a lasher located in a cave in the Passage of Time in Thaldraszus.

Greater Paracausal Chest is a quest reward from Realized Potential, the quest for reaching Legend of the Multiverse rank with Soridormi's friendship faction by completing Time Rifts activities in the Tyrhold Reservoir of Thaldraszus. It contains 70 Paracausal Flakes.

The Great Ossuary is located inside Scholomance, directly south of the large unnamed central chamber. The upper level is full of plagued dragon whelps and a few necromancers, and contain stairs and numerous chutes leading down into the ossuary proper. An ossuary is a recepticle where bones are buried, and huge piles of bony remains are stacked along the wall on the lower level. This is also where Rattlegore can be found. The ossuary is a dead-end, but players have to come here to obtain the Viewing Room Key if they wish to progress further into the instance by taking the eastern fork from the main chamber. The Death Knight Darkreaver could once be summoned here during The Divination Scryer,

The color green is used in World of Warcraft in various different ways. One way is as part of the usual Blizzard quality color system for items (gray, white, green, blue, purple, orange, gold) or difficulty for mobs (gray, green, yellow, orange, red) and tradeskill recipes (gray, green, yellow, orange).

Looting an item because you intend to sell it or pass it on to a friend or alt. This is an important distinction when looting with a party as it is considered polite to let those who need an item have it. Often abbreviated G in party conversation. Opposite of Need.

Gregor Greystone was a human quest giver located in Everlook in Winterspring. He was the representative for the Argent Dawn in the town. Argent Officer Pureheart is his superior. He has been missing since the Cataclysm, probably having left Everlook behind in his service to the Argent Crusade. His current whereabouts and status are unknown.

Greekik was Major Lorin Remka's slave in the internment camp that Remka commanded. Specifically, she was her cook. She was in the same internment camp as Thrall, and warned him of the news of Aedelas Blackmoore's arrival, enabling him to escape before Blackmoore arrived to identify him. Kelgar attacked Greekik in order to create a diversion to allow Thrall to escape, and while neither were badly hurt in the scuffle, they were likely beaten afterward as punishment. Her status afterwards is unknown.

A green wyrm is the adult stage of the green dragon life cycle. They are over 500 years old. Ysera is the main example of a green wyrm. She is a lithe and graceful green wyrm. Green wyrms can be found in the Emerald Dream.

__NOTOC__ Greengill Slaves are murlocs on the Greengill Coast of the Isle of Quel'Danas. Physically they are very small. They have been mind-controlled by the Darkspine Sirens and Darkspine Myrmidon in the area and are now neutral to players.

The Green Witch Hut is a living hut made of vines rises from the ground. Large enough to admit several people, the hut seems organically formed. Dark purple blossoms sprout from the walls and a cool, moss-scented breeze wafts from the open doorway.

Greg Street (alias Ghostcrawler) is the former Lead Systems Designer for World of Warcraft. He is now Head of Creative Development for Riot Games. On November 27, 2013 he announced on Facebook that he would be leaving Blizzard Entertainment to pursue a "great opportunity for something new and exciting". It was later officially confirmed on the forums, and he became Lead Game Designer at , before moving to his current position of Head of Creative Development. After leaving, he changed his Twitter handle to @OccupyGStreet on December 5, 2013. He has recently managed to retake his @Ghostcrawler account.
The Greatstaff of the Nexus can be found inside the Alexstrasza's Gift after defeating Malygos in the 10-man version of the Eye of Eternity.
Grekk is an orc quest giver stationed at Blue Sky Logging Grounds in the Grizzly Hills.
A Green Ribboned Holiday Gift is a Wrapped Gift Package container item which can be opened to loot a gift item. __NOTOC__

The Greatsword of the Sin'dorei is a two-handed sword that can be purchased by Horde characters from the different faction vendors in the Argent Tournament. This item is the weapon of choice for Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron. Curiously he wields it with only one hand. Whether this is an example of his own martial prowess or an unintentional in-game quirk is unknown.
Greedy is a Legacy achievement earned for winning a greed on a or better item above level 185 by rolling exactly 100.

The Greengill tribe is a tribe of murlocs found around the Greengill Coast on the Isle of Quel'Danas. They are being mind controlled by the Darkspine tribe of naga. Adventurers can use a Orb of Murloc Control to free the murlocs, who will then attack the nearest naga.
Gregory Tabor is a human quest giver for the Pilgrim's Bounty seasonal event. He handles several quests in the Pilgrim's Supplies quest chain.

Greela "The Grunt" Crankchain is a goblin found patrolling the Orgrimmar Embassy in Orgrimmar. She is dressed in the same attire as an Orgrimmar Grunt. She provides directions. Before the Cataclysm, she was located at the Ring of Valor as its organizer, standing next to War-Hunter Molog. She was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade.
The Greatsword of the Crown is a quest reward from A Fitting Weapon (Alliance).
Greef is an imp found in Cliffspring Hollow in Darkshore. He works for Apothecary Furrows, though Furrows doesn't seem to like him. Regardless, he will come to his master's defense if he is attacked.

Greenstone Masons' Quarter is a section of Greenstone Village used by the jade masons in the Jade Forest. The jade is brought here from the Greenstone Quarry and sent to the Serpent's Heart for construction of the jade statue.

Greenstone Quarry is a jade ore mine in northern Jade Forest, just to the west of the Greenstone Mason's Quarter and Emperor's Omen. While mining the pandaren accidentally opened a nest of shale spiders, which go crazy for the ore, causing them to go rampart and try to eat everything in sight. Due to the shale spiders' activities, the cavern has grown unstable and causing rubble to fall on the pandaren miners. Hao Mann is one of the first miners encountered.
Green Seedlings are orchids located in the Botanica. They are summoned by High Botanist Freywinn.
Greenstone Monks are pandaren located in Greenstone Village in the Jade Forest-
Greenstone Villagers are pandaren located in Greenstone Village in the Jade Forest.

Greenstone Miners are pandaren found in Greenstone Quarry in the Jade Forest. Some are seen panicked at the entrance, while others are trapped inside the mine by rocks. Once freed, they run towards the entrance, where they are seen sitting.
Greenstone Nibblers are shale spiders located in The Jade Forest.
Greenstone Gorgers are shale spiders located in The Jade Forest.

Greenstone Village is a pandaren village found in east-central Jade Forest between Dawn's Blossom, the Arboretum, and the Emperor's Omen. The pandaren still hold the village, as compared to the Mason's Quarter just north of town, which has been lost to Puckish Sprites. Graceful Swan runs the Greenstone Inn on the north side of the village.
__NOTOC__ Greenwood Thieves are found at Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.
__NOTOC__ Green Tea Leaves are gathered from herb nodes all over Pandaria with Herbalism (500). Green Tea Leaf bushes can be found in grassy areas away from water.
Greenstone Inn is the inn of Greenstone Village. Graceful Swan runs the inn behind the bar.

Green Cabbage Seeds are purchased from in the Halfhill Market for . It can be planted at Sunsong Ranch to grow Green Cabbage. Seeds can also rarely be found while harvesting at the farm.
__NOTOC__ Green Cabbage is a cooking ingredient. It can be found on any virmen on Pandaria as well as grown at Sunsong Ranch from Green Cabbage Seeds.

Greeb Ramrocket is a goblin located at Orgrimmar Skyway in Orgrimmar. He announces the arrival of The Mighty Wind.

The Greentill family of pandaren farmers lives in Stoneplow and tends to its fields in the Valley of the Four Winds. On Loon Mai's orders, adventurers of the Alliance and Horde were sent to evacuate them when the mantid invaded the area. Haiyun Greentill obliged, gathered his family, and left their farm.

Greedstones are found at various points in Revendreth. Interacting with it, will grant the buff Path of Greed causing a number of platforms to appear. Navigate them successfully within a minute to reach Greed's Reward.
Greed's Rewards are chests found in Revendreth. After interacting with a Greedstone, adventurers must navigate their way across several platforms in order to get their reward.

Griefing refers to the act of a player ruining the gaming experience of another player, either involuntarily or on purpose (though this is debatable from one server to another - see below). The most obvious form of griefing is constant stalking of a player, by either following him or her for no reason, whispering useless messages, repeatedly sending them invitations after they decline, etc. Griefers are those who engage in griefing.

The grell, also pluralized as grells and grellkin, are forest spirits that resemble imps but are generally larger in size and lack the characteristic horns. They are actually embodiments of the wild side of nature, and so tame ones are very rare. Brann Bronzebeard believes they may come from Aessina, though when he asked her she simply said, "maybe". The misty grell that dwell in the Misty Valley in the Swamp of Sorrows move as one with the wind and can summon gusts of breeze at their whim. In Teldrassil, many grell and grellkin moved into Shadowglen and infested the abandoned furbolg camps, threatening Shadowglen's residents. Like the furbolgs, the grell had been corrupted by :Fel Moss.
